crop.notes: Whole sporting-notes item, includes Schroeder/Bauer section.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that Joe Coburn left for New York without meeting Tom Allen, who had telegraphed he would fight him with gloves; it also covered the Bauer-Schroeder wrestling match.

facts.fact: Allen objected when Joe Coburn was billed in St. Louis as "Champion of the World"; Allen was engaged in Chicago for a week during Coburn's stay
Allen telegraphed the Dispatch on the 17th that he would fight Coburn with the gloves for all the money he could get; Coburn left for New York on Monday without a match
facts.quote: fight Coburn with the gloves for all the money he could get

notes: Half the item concerns wrestlers Bauer and Schroeder; the Allen part is the first paragraph. Quote is as paraphrased by the paper in quotation marks.
